title: Can I BEAT a Fly at Chess?
summary: Tony plays a fly: a simulated connectome of a fruit fly's ~160,000 neurons wired to play chess, with a 3D brain model whose regions light up (colour-coded, e.g. orange) as it 'thinks' and moves. Two hard-coded assists: it always takes mate-in-one and never walks into mate-in-one (like Martin). It hangs pieces constantly; Tony wins and estimates it at ~300 Elo (site claims ~700).
rules: Bot plays near-random/weak moves but always plays mate-in-one if available and never allows mate-in-one.

opponent.name: The Fly (fly connectome bot)
